title: The radar signature of a stealth shape
subtitle: The NASA almond: how much radar comes back, from every angle
hook: Shine radar on a smooth metal almond and very little comes back. Predict how little, from every angle.

media.alt: A radar pulse at 300 MHz sweeps over an aircraft 15 m long and scatters from it, in 3D
media.caption: The lab today: a radar pulse at 300 MHz meets an aircraft 15 m long, Maxwell's equations on a 3D grid. The almond asks for the returned signal to a fraction of a decibel.

note: In preparation: the cases, the outputs and their units are written here when the flag opens, and the measured values are sealed at the same moment (tools/flags.py seal).
